title: Plan further work
text: What would you do next if you had more time?

options.text: I would test the key assumption and compare the result with a stronger baseline.
options.response: 回答说明了关键条件和处理方法。

options.text: I would make the result look better.
options.response: 这一说法忽略了关键条件，需要重新分析。

options.text: I would run more experiments without a specific comparison.
options.response: 提到了部分处理方式，但解释还不完整。
